acceptance.command: grep -c "beforeRelease" src/subscribe-enumeration.test.ts; grep -n "beforeRelease" src/subscribe-timing.test.ts; grep -n "// ---- Self-check" src/subscribe-timing.test.ts; git diff "$BASE" HEAD -- src/subscribe-test-support.ts src/subscribe-timing.test.ts
acceptance.expected: R1–R4/A5: enumeration grep prints 0 (exit 1); timing hooks occur only after the Self-check marker, in the early-answer iteration and the new regression. Full diff inspection confirms optional beforeRelease(client: RawClient): Promise<void> | void is awaited exactly once after unchanged 50 turns and before both byte snapshot and release; earlyBytes uses bounded waitUntil on client.received().length > 0. Wrong-timeout variant and ordinary D22/enumeration callers get no hook. The gate opens only in the regression hook, which observes releaseStates ["live"] after bytes; all created servers use existing cleanups. Record review of both variants and why the registration-based timeout variant needs no byte wait.

acceptance.command:

base = os.environ["BASE"]

support = pathlib.Path("src/subscribe-test-support.ts").read_text()

assert not any(line.startswith("-") and not line.startswith("---") and "assert" in line for line in diff("src/subscribe-timing.test.ts").splitlines())

    "assert.throws(() => checkRequest(driven, { isCalling: true }), /0/);",

acceptance.command:
python3 -c 'import pathlib, re, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path("/tmp/891-runs")
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
statuses = []
timing_failures = []
for i in range(1, 51):
    log = root / f"run-{i}.log"
    assert not log.exists(), f"Refuse to overwrite stability evidence: {log}"
    with log.open("w") as stream:
        result = subprocess.run(["bun", "run", "test"], stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    statuses.append(result.returncode)
    print(f"run {i} exit {result.returncode}", flush=True)
    text = log.read_text()
    file = ""
    failures = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if re.match(r"^src/.*\.test\.ts:$", line):
            file = line
        if line.startswith("(fail)"):
            failures.append((file, line))
            print(f"{log}: {file} {line}", flush=True)
    summary = re.search(r"Ran \d+ tests across \d+ files", text)
    if summary:
        print(f"run {i}: {summary.group(0)}", flush=True)
    if (not summary or any(file == "src/subscribe-timing.test.ts:" or not file for file, _ in failures)
        or (result.returncode != 0 and not failures)):
        timing_failures.append(i)
    if not summary:
        print(f"run {i}: missing summary", flush=True)
print("completed runs", len(statuses))
print("nonzero exits", sum(status != 0 for status in statuses))
print("runs failing timing file", timing_failures)
assert len(statuses) == 50 and timing_failures == []'

acceptance.command:
: "${BASE_TREE:?Set BASE_TREE to a separate clean checkout at the recorded BASE with equivalent lockfile dependencies}"; python3 -c 'import os, pathlib, statistics, subprocess
base = os.environ["BASE"]
base_tree = pathlib.Path(os.environ["BASE_TREE"]).resolve()
head_tree = pathlib.Path.cwd()
assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=base_tree, text=True).strip() == base
assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=base_tree, text=True) == ""
values = {"base": [], "branch": []}
root = pathlib.Path("/tmp/891-cpu")
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for i in range(1, 6):
    for name, tree in [("base", base_tree), ("branch", head_tree)]:
        timing = root / f"{name}-{i}.time"
        log = root / f"{name}-{i}.log"
        with log.open("w") as stream:
            result = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/time", "-o", str(timing), "-f", "%U %S", "bun", "run", "test"], cwd=tree, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        parts = timing.read_text().splitlines()[-1].split()
        cpu = sum(map(float, parts))
        values[name].append(cpu)
        print(f"{name} {i}: user+system {cpu:.2f} s, exit {result.returncode}", flush=True)
for name, runs in values.items():
    print(f"{name} raw {runs}, median {statistics.median(runs):.2f} s")
print(f"delta {statistics.median(values['\''branch'\'']) - statistics.median(values['\''base'\'']):+.2f} s")'
acceptance.expected: A10/Performance impact: five interleaved pairs BASE, branch, BASE, branch, ... on the same machine, equivalent full-suite commands and dependencies. Report every user+system CPU value, status/failures, median of each 5 (sorted third value), and median(branch) minus median(base) rounded to 0.01 s. Information only on a shared noisy machine; no CPU threshold or claimed comparison to bench budget 3.4 s. Do not run Docker bench (#834).

acceptance.command:
python3 -c 'import pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="891-scope-") as directory:
    root = pathlib.Path(directory)
    def git(*args, code=0):
        result = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True)
        assert result.returncode == code, (args, result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
        return result.stdout
    git("init", "-q")
    git("config", "user.name", "Scope Fixture")
    git("config", "user.email", "fixture@example.invalid")
    for name in ["a.ts", "README.md", "docs/development.md"]:
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text("base\n")
    git("add", ".")
    git("commit", "-qm", "base")
    base = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
    def changed():
        (root / "README.md").write_text("protected change\n")
    def protected():
        return subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--exit-code", base, "HEAD", "--", "README.md", "docs/development.md"], cwd=root, capture_output=True).returncode
    def accepts():
        return (git("diff", "--name-only", base, "HEAD") == "a.ts\n"
                and git("diff", "--name-only", "--cached") == ""
                and git("diff", "--name-only") == ""
                and git("status", "--porcelain") == ""
                and protected() == 0)
    (root / "a.ts").write_text("allowed change\n")
    git("add", "a.ts")
    git("commit", "-qm", "allowed")
    allowed = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
    assert accepts()
    print("(a) allowed committed change: accepted")
    def reset():
        git("reset", "--hard", allowed)
        git("clean", "-fd")
    changed()
    git("add", "README.md")
    git("commit", "-qm", "forbidden")
    assert "README.md" in git("diff", "--name-only", base, "HEAD").splitlines()
    assert protected() == 1 and not accepts()
    print("(b) protected commit: rejected")
    reset()
    changed()
    git("add", "README.md")
    assert git("diff", "--name-only", "--cached") == "README.md\n" and not accepts()
    print("(c) protected index change: rejected")
    reset()
    changed()
    assert git("diff", "--name-only") == "README.md\n" and not accepts()
    print("(d) protected unstaged change: rejected")
    reset()
    (root / "stray.txt").write_text("untracked\n")
    assert git("status", "--porcelain") == "?? stray.txt\n" and not accepts()
    print("(e) untracked file: rejected")
    reset()
    changed()
    git("add", "README.md")
    git("restore", "--worktree", "--source=" + base, "README.md")
    git("diff", "--exit-code", base, "--", "README.md")
    assert git("diff", "--name-only", "--cached") == "README.md\n"
    assert git("diff", "--name-only") == "README.md\n"
    assert git("status", "--porcelain") == "MM README.md\n" and not accepts()
    print("(f) worktree-vs-base exit 0; cached README.md; unstaged README.md; status MM README.md: rejected")
    reset()
    changed()
    git("add", "README.md")
    git("commit", "-qm", "forbidden")
    git("restore", "--worktree", "--source=" + base, "README.md")
    git("diff", "--exit-code", base, "--", "README.md")
    assert git("diff", "--name-only", "--cached") == ""
    assert git("diff", "--name-only") == "README.md\n"
    assert git("status", "--porcelain") == " M README.md\n"
    assert "README.md" in git("diff", "--name-only", base, "HEAD").splitlines()
    assert protected() == 1 and not accepts()
    print("(g) worktree-vs-base exit 0; cached empty; unstaged README.md; status  M README.md; BASE..HEAD README.md; protected exit 1: rejected")
print("all seven fixture states passed; disposable fixture removed")'
acceptance.expected: A14: exit 0; (a) only allowed a.ts committed is accepted; (b) forbidden committed README, (c) staged README, (d) unstaged README, (e) untracked file, and (f)/(g) both restored-worktree traps are rejected by the combined checks. In (f) both cached and unstaged lists contain README.md, status MM README.md. In (g) cached is empty, unstaged contains README.md, status is " M README.md", BASE..HEAD lists README.md and protected diff exits 1. Both traps fool a BASE-to-worktree-only check (exit 0). Record all seven results in PR evidence; fixture is removed and never added to status.
